## New
- Home now opens with a "Because you watched" row of videos related to the last videos you watched
- The row shows up to fifteen suggestions, three from each of the last five videos you watched, refreshes when you reload Home, and opens a full page of suggestions from its title

## Improved
- The suggestions page loads more as you scroll, until your watch history runs out, and pull-to-refresh reloads it
- Watching a video adds its suggestions to the row as soon as you return Home, and "Not interested" removes a video from the row and its page for good
- The suggestions page has a list/grid switch in its top bar, like Subscriptions
